bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: MIN loai thang nghi (=0) bang mang: MIN(IF)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Thang nghi doanh thu =0 lam MIN(0) sai; IF>0 loc lay so duong roi MIN. CSE cho Excel cu; 365 dung MINIFS gon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Doanh thu T1-T12 co 0 thang nghi: =MIN(IF(B2:B13>0,B2:B13)) + CSE ra min that (vd 15) thay vi 0.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Quen CSE tren Excel cu nen ra 0/#VALUE!. Vung co text/rong lam IF loi; quen khoa vung khi copy.

cong_thuc.ten: Chuan bi Table dong (Ctrl+T) lam nguon Dashboard
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon 1 o trong vung > Ctrl+T (Insert > Table) > tich My table has headers > dat ten 'Du lieu'
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table tu mo rong ~5000 dong khi them thang moi; moi Pivot lay ten Table lam nguon nen Refresh la nap, khong sua Source.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Vung A1:F5000 thanh Table Du lieu; them thang 13 vao dong cuoi tu nam vao Table.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Khong tich Headers nen tieu de thanh data. Ten space/dau tieng Viet gay loi Source.

cong_thuc.ten: Tao Pivot tu Table + keo Nam/Thang > Rows, Doanh thu > Values
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click trong Table > Insert > PivotTable > New Worksheet > keo Nam/Thang vao Rows (Axis), Doanh thu vao Values (Sum)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Moi Pivot 1 sheet rieng cho gon; Rows liet ke thoi gian, Values tong tien. Sau dinh dang Tabular, tat Subtotal/Grand thua.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pivot1: Rows=Nam/Thang, Values=Sum Doanh thu theo thang de ve Line theo thoi gian.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo Nam vao Values/Text vao Values ra Count vo nghia. De pivot de len nhau lam mat Fields.

cong_thuc.ten: Report Layout Tabular + tat Grand/Subtotal thua
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Design > Report Layout > Show in Tabular Form; Subtotals/Grand Totals > Off khi khong can
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tabular tach moi field 1 cot ro hon Compact; tat tong thua cho chart Top/Bottom gon, chi giu tong khi can.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pivot Top SP: Tabular + Grand Off de chi thay Top 3 sach.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Tat Grand nhung chart % can tong nen sai ty trong. De Compact 2 cap don 1 cot kho doc.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Insert > PivotChart > chon Column/Line/Pie > OK. Doi sau: chuot phai chart > Change Chart Type
cong_thuc.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot nen loc/slicer tu nhay. Column so sanh, Line xu huong, Pie ty trong. Copy chart cu doi kieu nhanh hon ve moi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: PivotChart Column doanh thu theo thang; copy sang lam Pie % Khu vuc bang Change Type.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Ve Chart thuong thay vi PivotChart nen slicer khong dieu khien. Pie nhieu hon 6 lat cat nat kho doc.

cong_thuc.ten: Nhan ban PivotChart: Ctrl keo sheet + Ctrl keo chart
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Nhan ban sheet: giu Ctrl + keo tab sheet sang phai. Nhan ban chart: giu Ctrl + keo chart trong sheet
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhan sheet de co pivot+chart moi doc lap; nhan chart trong cung sheet de doi truong Legend/Axis thanh chart moi (Khu vuc -> NPP).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl-keo sheet chart Top 3 thanh sheet Bottom 3 roi doi Top sang Bottom. Ctrl-keo chart Khu vuc thanh chart NPP.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Nhan sheet nhung quen doi filter/field nen 2 chart giong het. Keo khong giu Ctrl thanh di chuyen mat ban goc.

cong_thuc.ten: Top 3 / Bottom 3 bang Value Filter Top 10
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten Row Labels > Value Filters > Top 10 > Show Top 3 by Sum of Doanh thu (Bottom cho te nhat)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Loc theo gia tri tong chu khong phai ten. Doi 10 thanh 3; Bottom cho 3 SP te nhat. Ket hop sort giam dan + reverse axis cho Top 1 len tren.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Row=San pham > Top 3 by Sum Doanh thu -> SP07, SP03, SP01 cao nhat. Doi Bottom 3 -> 3 SP thap nhat.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Loc Top theo Count thay vi Sum nen top sai. Quen sort nen Top 1 nam duoi cung.

cong_thuc.ten: Dao truc cho Top 1 len tren (Reverse)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai truc Category > Format Axis > tich Categories in reverse order
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chart cot ngang sort lon->be nhung Top 1 lai nam duoi; reverse dua Top 1 len tren cung de doc tu tren xuong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Top 3 sort giam dan nhung SP1 o duoi > Reverse -> SP1 len tren.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Reverse nham truc Value lam thang do dao. Reverse ca 2 truc gay roi.

cong_thuc.ten: Data Labels: Add + Category Name + Value + #,##0 + %
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai series > Add Data Labels. Format (Ctrl+1): tich Category Name + Value (+Percentage cho Pie); Number Custom #,##0
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cot hien so tien; Pie hien ten mien + tien (+%). #,##0 tach nghin (333333->333,333). Vi tri Outside End/Auto cho khoi de.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pie Khu vuc: tick Name+Value -> 'Mien Nam 40% 1,234,567'. Column: Outside End + #,##0.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Bat ca Name+Value+% +Leader lines lam Pie roi. De so dang General 1234567 kho doc.

cong_thuc.ten: Trang tri Series: Border + Smooth line
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon series > Ctrl+1 > Fill & Line > Border Solid line mau cam Width 2-3pt. Line chart: tich Smoothed line
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Vien cot tron dep, day 2-3pt mau thuong hieu; Smooth lam line cong mem thay vi goc canh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Cot vien cam 3pt; Line doanh thu tick Smooth de mem.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Vien qua day (>5pt) at cot; Smooth cho du lieu dot bien gay hieu lam xu huong.

cong_thuc.ten: Chart Title + Legend + resize bo cuc Dashboard
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click Title go ten (Top 3, Bottom 3, % Khu vuc...). Chart Elements (+) > Legend Top/Bottom. Keo goc resize + snap bo cuc 2x2/3x2
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Title ro muc dich tung chart; Legend chu thich mau; resize can doi de 4-5 chart vua 1 man hinh khong cuon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Title 'Doanh thu Top 3 SP', Legend Bottom, resize 4 chart vua sheet Dashboard.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De title mac dinh 'Chart 1' khong biet chart gi. Keo chart che slicer/nut loc.

cong_thuc.ten: Doi truong chart: Khu vuc -> Nha phan phoi
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click chart > PivotChart Fields > bo Khu vuc khoi Legend/Axis > keo Nha phan phoi vao thay
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tan dung chart cu doi chieu phan tich ma khong ve moi: thay field Legend/Axis giu nguyen kieu Pie/Column.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tu Pie % Khu vuc: bo Khu vuc, keo NPP vao -> Pie % NPP (FPT 30%...).
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo them ma khong bo cu nen chart 2 chieu vo nghia. Doi field nhung quen doi Title gay sai ten.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon Pivot > PivotTable Analyze > Insert Slicer > tich Nam, Thang, Khu vuc, Nha phan phoi > OK. Sap xep 4 slicer quanh Dashboard.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: 4 slicer dieu khien toan dashboard: Nam/Thang thoi gian, Khu vuc/NPP khong gian kenh. Copy slicer cu dung lai nhanh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: 4 slicer tren dau Dashboard: Nam (2019/2020), Thang (1-12), Khu vuc, NPP.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chen slicer tu 1 pivot rieng le nen chua noi cac pivot khac. De slicer qua nho bam kho.

cong_thuc.ten: Report Connections: 1 slicer dieu khien all chart
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai moi Slicer > Report Connections (PivotTable Connections) > tich TAT CA PivotTable cua dashboard > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Buoc song con cua dashboard: noi moi slicer toi moi pivot/chart. Thieu 1 tick la chart do dung yen khi loc -> lech. Test 2020 xem all nhay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer Nam tick Pivot1..Pivot5; bam 2020 ca 5 chart deu doi theo 2020.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Loi pho bien nhat: quen tick 1 pivot (chart lech). Them pivot moi sau ma quen noi lai slicer.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Slicer header: bieu tuong Multi-select (3 o) de chon nhieu; bieu tuong Clear (loc X) de xoa loc
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Multi chon nhieu nam/thang de so sanh; Clear tra ve all de test dong bo sau moi lan loc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bat Multi chon 2019+2020 so sanh; Clear de ve trang thai all truoc khi gui sep.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Khong bat Multi nen mat chon cu. Quen Clear truoc khi gui nen sep mo thay dashboard dang loc do.

cong_thuc.ten: Refresh + an sheet phu + test + luu file song
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Them thang moi vao Table > moi pivot Right-click > Refresh (Refresh All). Chon nhieu sheet phu > Hide. Test tung slicer. Luu XLSX (giu Pivot+Slicer song)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table mo rong + Refresh nap thang moi. Hide sheet trung gian chi giu Dashboard sach. Gui file song de sep tu bam slicer, khong gui anh chet/PDF tinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them T13 > Refresh All > test Nam 2020, Thang 3, Khu vuc Nam -> all chart nhay dung > Hide sheets phu > luu Dashboard.xlsx gui.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Them data ngoai Table + khong Refresh nen dashboard cu. Gui PDF/anh lam mat tuong tac slicer. Quen Hide sheet rac gay roi.

cau_hoi.cau: Vi sao phai doi vung thanh Table truoc dashboard?
cau_hoi.A: De tu mo rong khi them dong, Pivot tu cap nhat
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Table nap dong moi vao Pivot qua Refresh.

cau_hoi.cau: Phim tat tao Table la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+T mo Create Table.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi tao Table can tick gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bao dong dau la tieu de.

cau_hoi.cau: Pivot tao tu nguon nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dat ten Table roi lay lam Source dong.

cau_hoi.cau: Nen dat Pivot moi o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Sheet rieng gon, sau copy ve Dashboard.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo Nam/Thang vao dau? Doanh thu vao dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Rows liet ke, Values tinh tong.

cau_hoi.cau: Tabular Form de lam gi?
cau_hoi.C: Hien dang bang tach cot ro
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ro hon Compact khi nhieu cap.

cau_hoi.cau: Grand/Subtotal thua thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Gon chart Top/Bottom.

cau_hoi.cau: Ve bieu do tu Pivot dung lenh nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot, nhay theo loc.

cau_hoi.cau: Nhan ban sheet chart nhanh bang gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nhan ban de lam chart bien the.

cau_hoi.cau: Nhan ban chart trong cung sheet bang gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+drag copy chart roi doi field.

cau_hoi.cau: Loc Top 3 SP cao nhat dung gi?
cau_hoi.D: Row Labels > Value Filter > Top 10 doi 10 thanh 3
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Top theo Sum Doanh thu.

cau_hoi.cau: Xem 3 SP te nhat thi chon gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bottom cho thap nhat.

cau_hoi.cau: Top 1 lai nam duoi cung sau sort thi sua sao?
cau_hoi.B: Format Axis > Categories in reverse order
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dao truc dua lon len tren.

cau_hoi.cau: Hien so tien tren cot dung gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Right-click series > Add.

cau_hoi.cau: Pie muon hien ca ten mien + tien thi tick gi?
cau_hoi.D: Format Data Labels > Category Name + Value
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick ca ten + gia tri.

cau_hoi.cau: 333333 thanh 333,333 thi format gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Custom tach nghin.

cau_hoi.cau: Them % canh so tien tren Pie thi tick gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick Percentage them ty trong.

cau_hoi.cau: Line goc canh muon mem thi tick gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Format Series > Smooth.

cau_hoi.cau: Vien cot cam day 3pt chinh o dau?
cau_hoi.D: Format Data Series > Border Solid line Width 3pt
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon mau + do rong vien.

cau_hoi.cau: Ten Top 3, Bottom 3 dat o dau?
cau_hoi.A: Chart Title (sua thanh Doanh thu Top 3...)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Title ro muc dich chart.

cau_hoi.cau: Them chu thich mau bang gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick Legend keo vi tri hop.

cau_hoi.cau: Tu Pie Khu vuc muon thanh Pie NPP thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.C: Bo Khu vuc khoi Legend, keo NPP vao (PivotChart Fields)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Doi truong Legend/Axis.

cau_hoi.cau: Chart qua to/nho thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.D: Keo goc resize cho vua bo cuc Dashboard
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Snap 2x2/3x2 can doi.

cau_hoi.cau: Slicer de lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Nut loc truc quan Nam/Thang/Khu vuc/NPP
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bam loc dong loat.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen Slicer bang cach nao?
cau_hoi.B: Chon Pivot > Analyze > Insert Slicer (chon 4 truong)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 4 truong Nam/Thang/Khu vuc/NPP.

cau_hoi.cau: Lam sao 1 Slicer loc TAT CA chart?
cau_hoi.C: Right-click Slicer > Report Connections > tick het pivot
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Noi slicer toi moi PivotTable.

cau_hoi.cau: Quen tick 1 pivot trong Connections thi sao?
cau_hoi.D: Chart do dung yen, lech so lieu
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Phai tick het de dong bo.

cau_hoi.cau: Bam 2020 ma 1 chart khong doi thi kiem tra gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chart chua noi slicer.

cau_hoi.cau: Bam nam 2020 thi thao tac nao dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Slicer loc 1 gia tri.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon nhieu nam/thang de so sanh thi dung gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick nhieu muc.

cau_hoi.cau: Xoa loc slicer de ve all thi bam gi?
cau_hoi.D: Clear Filter (bieu tuong loc X) tren slicer
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Clear tra ve all de test.

cau_hoi.cau: An sheet phu chi giu Dashboard bang gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Shift chon roi Hide cho sach.

cau_hoi.cau: Them thang moi vao Table roi pivot chua thay thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Table mo rong, Refresh nap.

cau_hoi.cau: Cong thuc MIN loai thang nghi 0 la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Loc >0 roi MIN, bo qua 0 nghi.

cau_hoi.cau: Nguon ~5000 dong thi luu y gi?
cau_hoi.D: Dung Table+Pivot tu dong, tranh cong thuc mang nang
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Pivot xu ly nghin dong nhanh.

cau_hoi.cau: Muc dich cuoi dashboard la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Theo doi doanh thu nam/thang, top/bottom SP, ty trong vung/NPP 1 man hinh
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Mot man hinh thay moi goc kinh doanh.

cau_hoi.cau: Hoan thien gui sep can test gi cuoi?
cau_hoi.B: Bam tung slicer xem all chart nhay dung + Refresh + Hide sheet phu roi luu
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Kiem tra dong bo roi gui file song.

cau_hoi.cau: Gui dashboard cho sep nen gui dang nao?
cau_hoi.C: Excel XLSX giu Pivot+Slicer song de sep tu loc
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu tuong tac, khong gui anh chet/PDF tinh.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo chart che mat slicer thi xu ly the nao?
cau_hoi.D: Resize + keo chart/slicer lai cho khong de, snap bo cuc
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bo cuc thoang moi bam duoc.

thuat_ngu_chuan.giai_thich: Mot man hinh tong hop nhieu chart + slicer.
Loc Top/Bottom N theo tong gia tri.
Nap thang moi tu Table vao Pivot.
